accessibilite_page.sec1_p1: Oaksome is committed to making its website accessible to all users, in accordance with European Directive 2016/2102 and applicable Belgian legislation. We aim for compliance with the W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 level AA.
accessibilite_page.sec1_p2: We consider accessibility as a continuous effort: each evolution of the site is reviewed to preserve and improve the experience of people with disabilities, whether visual, hearing, motor or cognitive impairment.
accessibilite_page.sec2_p1: This declaration applies to the oaksome.com site, in its French and Dutch versions, as well as to the associated customer area. It covers public pages (catalogue, collections, spaces, marketing content) and authenticated pages (account, projects, appointments).
accessibilite_page.sec2_p2: The 3D configurator embedded via oaksome-client.vercel.app is a third-party component: it is integrated into the site but hosted separately. Its accessibility is subject to specific monitoring with its publisher.
accessibilite_page.sec3_p1_before: As of the date of this publication, the site is
accessibilite_page.sec3_p1_after: with the WCAG 2.1 AA standard. An internal evaluation was conducted by our product team; an external audit is planned before the end of the year.
accessibilite_page.sec4_intro: The following are not yet fully compliant:
accessibilite_page.sec4_item1_text: WebGL visualization cannot be controlled using the keyboard alone. A textual alternative (configuration via form) is available on the same page.
accessibilite_page.sec4_item2_text: navigation by keyboard arrows is partial; a refresh is planned.
accessibilite_page.sec4_item3_text: certain secondary texts on a beige background do not reach the AA ratio (4.5:1) on low-calibration screens. An adjustment of the secondary palette is in progress.
accessibilite_page.sec4_item4_text: the PDF documents generated (invoices, quotes) are structured but are not systematically labeled (tagged PDF).
accessibilite_page.sec5_p1: The accessibility of the site is based on semantic HTML5, CSS and progressively enriched JavaScript. The site is tested with recent versions of Firefox, Chrome, Safari and Edge, and with NVDA and VoiceOver screen readers.

garantie_page.entretien_subtitle: A few simple steps to preserve your furniture over time.
garantie_page.entretien_placage_p: Soft, slightly damp cloth. No abrasive products. Avoid prolonged direct exposure to sunlight.
garantie_page.entretien_laque_p: Dry or slightly damp microfiber cloth. Fingerprints come off easily. No solvent.
garantie_page.entretien_stratifie_p: Durable surface. Cleaning with soapy water. Dry after cleaning to avoid streaks.
garantie_page.faq_q1: Is the guarantee transferable in the event of sale of the property?

garantie_page.faq_q2: What to do if the problem is not covered?
garantie_page.faq_a2: We offer you a repair estimate. No obligation. Spare parts remain available for the duration of the warranty.
garantie_page.faq_a3: Yes, the invoice serves as proof of purchase. We also keep a copy in your customer area.
garantie_page.faq_q4: Are the hinges and slides guaranteed?
garantie_page.faq_a4: Yes. All hardware is covered for 10 years. A hinge, slide or push-to-open mechanism malfunction is taken care of.

prise_mesures_page.intro: Accurate measurements are essential for a perfect built-in cabinet. Follow our step-by-step guide or book a visit from our technician.
prise_mesures_page.step1_p: Completely empty the area where the furniture will be installed. Remove baseboards if necessary. Make sure the floor and walls are clear to allow accurate measurements.
prise_mesures_page.step2_p: Take 3 width measurements: top, middle and bottom of the space. Note the smallest measurement. This will determine the maximum width of your piece of furniture. Measure in millimeters for accuracy.
prise_mesures_page.step3_p: Take 3 height measurements: left, center and right. Keep the measurement smallest. If the ceiling is sloped, note the two extreme heights.
prise_mesures_page.step4_p: Measure the available depth taking into account protruding elements: electrical sockets, pipes, switches, radiators. The usable depth is the minimum free space available.
prise_mesures_page.step5_p: Note the exact position of all obstacles: electrical outlets, switches, baseboards, moldings, pipes, windows, doors. Measure their position relative to the floor and walls. Take photos of each obstacle.
prise_mesures_page.illus_caption: Interactive diagram of upcoming measuring points in the configurator.
prise_mesures_page.tip1_p: Check that your walls and floor are level. Deviations common in older construction can affect installation.
prise_mesures_page.tip2_p: The golden rule: measure twice, order once. Check each measurement by taking it a second time to avoid any errors.
prise_mesures_page.tip3_p: Take photos of the space from different angles. This helps our team better understand your environment and anticipate constraints.
prise_mesures_page.download_p: Download and print our sheet to easily record your measurements.
prise_mesures_page.cta_p: Our technicians will come to your home free of charge to take the exact measurements.

tva6_page.sec1_p1: Belgian legislation provides for a VAT rate reduced to 6% (instead of 21%) for certain real estate renovation, transformation, improvement, repair and maintenance work carried out in private housing.
tva6_page.sec1_p2: At Oaksome, we apply this reduced rate as soon as the legal conditions are met. Our team checks your eligibility at the time of the quote.
tva6_page.sec2_intro: To benefit from 6% VAT, the following conditions must be met:
tva6_page.sec2_item1_text: the property must be more than 10 years old on the date the work begins.
tva6_page.sec2_item2_text: the accommodation must be used, after the work, exclusively or mainly as a private dwelling.
tva6_page.sec2_item3_text: the work is provided and invoiced directly to the end consumer (owner, tenant, usufructuary).
tva6_page.sec2_item4_text: it must be renovation, transformation, improvement, repair or maintenance — not new construction.
tva6_page.sec2_item5_text: the work is carried out by an approved contractor who invoices on their behalf.
tva6_page.sec3_p1_before: To apply the reduced rate, we ask you to sign a
tva6_page.sec3_p1_after: certifying that the above conditions are met. This certificate is mandatory and engages your responsibility for the information declared.
tva6_page.sec3_p2: The certificate is attached to your quote. You sign it before starting work. We keep it for the legal period (10 years) with the corresponding invoice.
tva6_page.sec4_title: What the 6% rate covers at Oaksome
tva6_page.sec4_intro: For an eligible project, the reduced rate applies to the entire Oaksome service:
tva6_page.sec4_item3: Installation and installation by our teams
tva6_page.sec4_item4: Finishes and connections integrated into installation
tva6_page.sec4_note: Free furniture (not built-in, not fixed) remains in principle subject to standard VAT of 21%. We always specify the applicable rate item by item on the quote.
tva6_page.sec5_item1_label: New or recent housing (less than 10 years old):
tva6_page.sec5_item2_text: a separate regime exists under strict conditions (zones and social criteria). We study it on a case by case basis.
tva6_page.sec5_item3_text: the 6% rate does not apply to offices, businesses and premises not intended for private housing.
tva6_page.sec5_item4_text: only mainly private use allows the application of the reduced rate on the whole.
tva6_page.sec6_p1: Every project is different. If you have any doubt about the application of the 6% rate to your situation, contact us: we will check with you at the time of the quote.
tva6_page.sec6_disclaimer: This page has informative value and does not replace official regulations (VAT Code, AR n° 20). Official source: finances.belgium.be.

engagements.intro: Each Oaksome piece of furniture carries our beliefs: local manufacturing, responsible materials, lasting quality.
engagements.s1_p1: Our workshop is located in Fleurus, in the heart of Hainaut. Each piece of furniture is produced on site, from CNC cutting to final assembly. No subcontracting, no intermediaries.
engagements.s1_p2: Result: controlled deadlines, total traceability and a team that is accountable for its work.
engagements.s1_alt: General view of the Fleurus workshop
engagements.s2_p1: Our panel and hardware suppliers are European. We favor Belgian and neighboring supplies to reduce transport distances.
engagements.s2_p2: Fewer kilometers, more responsiveness. And direct quality control on each batch.
engagements.s2_alt: Stock of melamine panels and wood veneers
engagements.s3_p1: The panels we use are PEFC or FSC certified, guaranteeing responsible forest management. Formaldehyde emissions meet the E1 standard or higher.
engagements.s3_p2: We select suppliers who share our requirements: sustainably, without compromising on quality.
engagements.s3_alt: Close-up natural wood veneer — grain and texture
engagements.s4_p1: Hinges, drawer slides, lifting systems: we equip all our furniture with Blum hardware, a world reference in the sector.
engagements.s4_p2: Blum tests its mechanisms at 200,000 opening cycles. This is the guarantee of a piece of furniture that will work as well in 15 years as it did on the first day.
engagements.s4_alt: Blum hinge detail installed — precision mechanism
engagements.s5_p1: Each Oaksome piece of furniture is covered by a 10-year commercial guarantee, in addition to the 2-year legal guarantee. This warranty covers defects in workmanship and materials under normal conditions of use.
engagements.s5_p2: A problem? A single contact person supports you until resolution.
engagements.s5_alt: Dressing room installed for several years — finishes intact
engagements.s6_p1: No furniture is produced in advance. Each part is manufactured only after validation of your order and confirmation of measurements on site.
engagements.s6_p2: Zero waste, zero unsold items. A piece of furniture designed for your space, with exactly the dimensions you need.
engagements.s6_alt: CNC operator with customer technical plan
engagements.cta_body: Configure your custom furniture and benefit from local, responsible manufacturing and a 10-year guarantee.

faq.intro: Everything you need to know about Oaksome and our custom built furniture.
faq.cta_intro: Our team is here to help you.
faq.q1_a: Our online configurator allows you to personalize every aspect of your furniture: dimensions, type of doors, finishes and colors. You view your furniture in real time and get an instant price. Once satisfied, add to cart and place order. An advisor will then contact you to organize measures to be taken.
faq.q2_a: Our average lead times are 6 to 8 weeks after validation of the technical plan. This deadline includes custom manufacturing in our workshops and delivery with installation. Exact deadlines are confirmed after measurements have been taken and the final plan validated.
faq.q3_q: Can I modify my order after validation?
faq.q3_a: You can modify your order until the technical plan is validated. After this step, production starts and modifications are no longer possible. Contact your dedicated advisor for any change requests.
faq.q4_q: What are the options for viewing materials before ordering?
faq.q4_intro: We offer 3 levels of reinsurance depending on your needs:
faq.q4_b1_desc: — Choose up to 3 sets of 2 colors (exterior + interior). Delivered to your home in 3-5 days. No commitment.
faq.q4_b2_desc: — Receive an A4 size door in your color, a handle and an interior panel. One kit per collection.
faq.q4_b3_desc: — Our salesperson comes to your home with the showroom van to show you the collections in real life and take measurements of your space. The €250 is fully refunded upon ordering.
faq.q4_outro: You can also order directly online if you are already convinced by the configurator.
faq.q5_q: Are the €250 for the mobile showroom really reimbursed?
faq.q5_a: Yes, completely. If you place an order following the mobile showroom visit, the €250 is deducted from your invoice. The visit also includes taking measurements, which saves you the separate measurement stage.
faq.q6_a: Yes, installation is included in our prices. Our professional teams ensure the delivery and complete assembly of your furniture. Installation typically takes half a day depending on the complexity of the project.
faq.q7_a: All our furniture comes with a 10-year warranty covering manufacturing and material defects. The warranty applies under normal conditions of use. We also offer responsive after-sales service for any questions or adjustments.
faq.q8_q: How does the right of withdrawal work?
faq.q8_a: As our furniture is custom made to your exact specifications, the standard 14-day right of withdrawal does not apply in accordance with European legislation (article VI.53 of the Code of Economic Law). We encourage you to order samples and use the configurator before validating.
faq.q9_a: We currently deliver to Belgium and Luxembourg. Expansion to France is planned soon. For border areas, do not hesitate to contact us to check if delivery is possible.
faq.q10_q: How do I maintain my Oaksome furniture?
faq.q10_a: Simple maintenance is enough: wipe regularly with a soft, slightly damp cloth. Avoid abrasive products and excess water. For natural wood finishes, an oil treatment once a year preserves the luster of the wood. Each order comes with a detailed care guide.
faq.q11_a: Several options are available to you: by email via our contact form, by telephone at +32 2 899 42 00 (Mon-Fri, 9 a.m.-6 p.m.), or by making an appointment in our showroom in Brussels. If you have an order in progress, your dedicated advisor is your preferred contact.

about.hero_p: Custom built-in furniture, designed to fit perfectly into your interior. Designed in Belgium, manufactured in our workshops.
about.mission_p1: At Oaksome, we believe that custom built-in furniture should not be a luxury reserved for the few. We combine the artisanal expertise of our Belgian workshops with modern digital tools to offer a simple, transparent and controlled experience.
about.mission_p2: Each piece of furniture is designed to the centimeter for your exact space. From online configurator to final installation, we support you every step of the way. Our promise: a clear price, a respected deadline, and controlled quality.
